+def load_quantities(path: Path, inventory: Inventory, what: str) -> Dict[int, int]:

+    """Parse a '{Item Name} {Quantity} ...' file into typeID -> quantity.

+

+    Anything after the quantity is ignored; blank lines and '#' comments are skipped.

+    """

+    if not path.is_file():

+        raise PlanError(f"{what} file not found: {path}")

+    folded: Dict[str, List[InvType]] = defaultdict(list)

+    for name, items in inventory.types_by_name.items():

+        folded[name.lower()].extend(items)

+    quantities: Dict[int, int] = defaultdict(int)

+    with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8-sig") as fh:

+        for number, line in enumerate(fh, 1):

+            tokens = line.split()

+            if not tokens or tokens[0].startswith("#"):

+                continue

+            parsed = _parse_quantity_line(tokens, inventory, folded)

+            if parsed is None:

+                raise PlanError(f"{what} file {path}, line {number}: cannot parse '{line.strip()}'")

+            type_id, quantity = parsed

+            quantities[type_id] += quantity

+    return dict(quantities)

+

+

+def _parse_quantity_line(tokens: List[str], inventory: Inventory,

+                         folded: Dict[str, List[InvType]]) -> Optional[Tuple[int, int]]:

+    # Longest item name first, so names containing numbers still resolve.

+    for split in range(len(tokens) - 1, 0, -1):

+        match = _QUANTITY_RE.match(tokens[split])

+        if not match:

+            continue

+        name = " ".join(tokens[:split])

+        items = inventory.published_by_name(name) or sorted(

+            folded.get(name.lower(), []), key=lambda t: t.type_id)

+        if items:

+            return items[0].type_id, int(match.group(1).replace(",", "").replace("_", ""))

+    return None
